notes.title: Shaping the future - Climbing Gym Simulator [Devlog #3]
notes.notes: [p][i]As always, all those amazing screenshots you see here were made by the community.[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45572834/b81dd8f1138f4537c7e1e291acdea5c74afce3ee.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]It’s been a while.[/b][/p][p]Well, what can I say, I’m not too consistent when it comes to writing devlogs, but at the same time it’s simply difficult to wear all the hats of solo development. Nevertheless, I’m excited about what’s being made and what the future holds.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45572834/2325f971154989f95033521c71d20723b562b7ae.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Climbing Holds?[/b][/p][p]Speaking of holds, how can I ensure we have enough of them for you to have fun in the game? Since this game idea was born, I knew there was gonna be a big focus on community sharing. Aside from a basic set of holds I’m gonna provide, you’ll be able to easily share and download content made by other players! Sounds cool? Let’s see what some of you have to say about this![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45572834/6a8f58202c4e26c35c5f0fd92de4d300ac9722e7.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Wanna take part in the next polls? [url="https://discord.gg/PSPPtkNVTt"]Make sure to join Discord server.[/url][/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]In-game holds editor (?)[/b][/p][p]Shaping your own holds in the inventory room of your gym seems like an amazing idea. Most of you would prefer that to be part of the in-game systems, which I’m also considering and will most likely make a reality once I deal with the optimization issues that come with it.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45572834/fda0c4d159e9994957671dd19e1b5e3867a674e5.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Utilities[/b][/p][p]During the previous playtest there were concerns about reaching high walls, box clutter, and the lack of a human-body reference during routesetting. That’s how the utility bar was born. Now you can deploy and retrieve different objects: empty boxes, ladders, and a dummy. I’m not gonna explain it further, as most are self-explanatory, but the most fun is that you’ll be able to throw a dummy on your route to test-climb it.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45572834/0a2f0f418b87976494a4d79af1ca052a5614b229.png"][/img][/p][p][b]What’s next?[/b][/p][p]Right now I’m:[/p][list][*][p]Finishing all the building tools[/p][/*][*][p]Working on the tutorial[/p][/*][*][p]Overthinking the UI and redesigning it until I’m happy ːsteamfacepalmː[/p][/*][*][p]Prototyping NPC climbing[/p][/*][*][p]Battling bugs and adding QoL features[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks to everyone who played, tested, broke stuff, and sent in ideas. Your interaction and commitment are making the game better every day.[/p][p][/p][p] [b]Make sure to follow and add Climbing Gym Simulator to your wishlist![/b][/p]

notes.title: Unleash your creativity! - Climbing Gym Simulator [Devlog #2]
notes.notes: [p][i]All the amazing screenshots you see here were made by the community.[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45572834/4c64a6ad633b61ef25ced9043289a431abd4e4a3.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Some beautiful things are happening.[/b][/p][p]The first private playtest just went live and has already brought in some fantastic feedback and suggestions. It’s been amazing to see players interact with the systems, break things I didn’t expect, and come up with ideas I never would’ve thought of on my own.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45572834/59671475c2190acb2588b8dcdcd8c08aa60c227a.png"][/img][/p][p][b]What’s included in the playtest?[/b][/p][p]Right now, the focus is on the [b]core experience[/b]: building walls, placing holds, and setting routes. There are no climbers or open gym yet. This first version is all about giving you full creative control and seeing how people approach route setting and gym design with zero hand-holding.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45572834/ba8147caa3f44e4c7787cb88824ae89dc7175205.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Why release it so early?[/b][/p][p]I wanted to validate the feel of the core mechanics and gather real feedback as early as possible. Seeing how players build, organize, and interact with the systems has been incredibly valuable. And honestly, it’s just way more fun to build the game with a community than alone in a vacuum.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45572834/21f0c087ba9cff7e343b6af1c6b44d196cdcfb26.png"][/img][/p][p][b]What’s next?[/b][/p][p]Right now I’m:[/p][list][*][p]Fixing bugs and adding some QoL improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Wrapping up the core building features[/p][/*][*][p]Starting to shift focus toward tycoon and simulation elements[/p][/*][*][p]Managing the community and dropping fun social media content here and there[/p][/*][/list][p]Things are moving fast and your feedback is what’s driving it.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45572834/ce16cd49aa2acf760e79f69f0e8403a44378be70.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Thanks to everyone who played, tested, broke stuff, and sent in ideas. This interaction and your commitment is making the game better every day.[/p][p][/p][p] [b]Make sure to follow and add Climbing Gym Simulator to your wishlist![/b][/p]

notes.title: Dream Big, Climb Higher - Climbing Gym Simulator [Devlog #1]
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45572834/c71a91123b8063a33f067516ddef0e582ea0e8f9.jpg[/img]

[b]Let’s kick off with a quick introduction.[/b]

If you’re into climbing, you’ve probably dreamed of opening your own gym or at least building a home wall. Since that usually takes a lot of funding and effort, I decided to live that dream through a game instead - and when it turned out to be way more fun and creative than I expected, I knew I had to share it with you.

[b]Is this game for non-climbers too?[/b]

If you’re not a climber and wondering if this game might still be for you - think of it like building a giant playground and watching monkeys (well, slightly bigger ones) swinging and struggling around your creations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45572834/8e2126a7e9e09a298446abcab6ff15b55ccb0ec0.jpg[/img]
[i]V2 in my gym.[/i]

[b]What is Climbing Gym Simulator?[/b]

In [i]Climbing Gym Simulator[/i], you run your own gym: building walls, placing holds, setting routes, and watching physics-based NPC climbers attempt them. You can’t climb yourself (for now!) - the focus is on creativity, management, and a bit of chaos.

[b]How does the game start?[/b]

You’ll start with an empty warehouse and a big loan. Sign your first deal, build your gym, attract customers, and expand.

[b]What's the goal?[/b]

Grow big, pay it all back, and have tons of fun.

[b]Thanks for checking it out![/b]
